summary: Playoffs Enabled Toggle (Iter 232N.89) fully tested - Backend: 7/7 tests PASS, Frontend: All UI elements verified across LeagueSetupTab and SetupWizard ScheduleStep. Toggle saves via PUT API, persists across refresh, and correctly controls visibility of playoff-related UI elements.

Frontend SetupWizard ScheduleStep: Toggle controls visibility of playoff start/end inputs and consolation section, budget calculator correctly shows 0 playoff weeks when disabled

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playoffs enabled toggle feature complete. The toggle auto-saves via PUT /api/leagues/{id} with playoffs_enabled field. When disabled, playoff validation is skipped (invalid playoff config accepted), playoff-related UI elements are hidden/disabled, and season budget calculator excludes playoff weeks. State persists across page refresh.

backend_api.PUT /api/leagues/{id} with playoffs_enab: Saves value, returns in response, persists to DB
backend_api.GET /api/leagues/{id}: Returns playoffs_enabled field (defaults to true for legacy leagues)
backend_api.Playoff validation when disabled: Skipped - invalid playoff config (end < start) accepted without error
backend_api.Playoff validation when enabled: Enforced - invalid playoff config returns 400 error

frontend_ui.persistence: Toggle state persists across page refresh
